columns: Plant POL IN F CAKE DS
Plant POL IN F MOL DS
tables.purpose: Primary DMR daily metrics; Date column is the sole date slicer anchor for all KPIs.
Cane indent totals and overrun gate/center denominators.
Cane purchase totals and overrun ratios.
Middle brix yard KPI and sparkline.
Middle brix field KPI and sparkline.
Fallback and daily overlays for yard balance, crush, juice, sugar, maceration.
Fallback pol, bagasse, filter cake, and mol metrics.
Power generation, export, consumption, per-cane and per-sugar ratios; latest row per Date deduped.
Steam generation, steam to sugar, bagasse ratios, specific steam; StmCons3Old70/StmCons3New70 mapped from StmCons3Old35/StmCons3New35.
Distillery throughput, storage, efficiency, TRS/FS; latest row per Date deduped.

rows.name: Days
rows.description: Count of DMR daily records in the selected From-To range. Matches Power BI Days elapsed (COUNTROWS of DMR in slicer).
rows.formula: dmrRows.filter(r => dateKey(r.Date)).length after SELECT * FROM dmr_daily WHERE Date BETWEEN From AND To
rows.comparison: Not compared

rows.name: 7 DMA
rows.description: Static label showing the moving-average window length from the dma query parameter (default 7).
rows.comparison: Not compared

rows.name: Compare period label
rows.description: Suffix on compare chips: prior or season label plus short formatted start-end dates.
rows.source: resolveCockpitCompareRange(from, to, compareType, seasonLabels, seasonMapping, preset)
rows.comparison: Not compared

rows.name: MTD
rows.description: Month-to-date: From = 1st of current calendar month, To = latest DMR date clamped to bounds.
rows.formula: getCockpitPresetDateRange("MTD", ref, seasonMapping); clampRange to dmr_daily min/max
rows.comparison: PP chip label: Prev. Month

rows.name: STD
rows.description: Season-to-date: From = season_mapping startDate for To season, else Oct 1 of crushing season; To = latest DMR date.
rows.comparison: PP chip label: Prev. Season (day-of-season offset when mapping present)

rows.name: WTD
rows.description: Week-to-date: From = Monday of week containing To, To = latest DMR date.
rows.comparison: PP chip label: Prev. Week

rows.name: Custom
rows.description: User-selected From and To dates; preset switches to Custom when date inputs change.
rows.comparison: PP chip label: Prev. Period (equal-length window ending day before From)

rows.name: Prev. Period / Prev. Month / Prev. Season / Prev. Week
rows.description: PP compare chip triggers a second GET /bi/management-dashboard call for the parallel prior window.
rows.formula: resolveCockpitPriorRange(from, to, preset, seasonMapping) or computePriorPeriodRange
rows.comparison: This window is the comparison source for all compare % chips

rows.name: Season compare chips
rows.description: Each mapped season except current; STD uses day-of-season offset, other presets use calendar month/day alignment.
rows.comparison: Season label becomes compare label on chips

rows.name: Cane Indent (Q)
rows.description: Total cane indent quantity in quintals for the selected date range.
rows.formula: SUM(centre_indent_data.indent_qty) WHERE indent_date IS NOT NULL AND indent_date BETWEEN From AND To
rows.comparison: normal: green when positive % change; (current - prior) / Math.abs(prior) * 100; null if current or prior null/blank or prior=0; Chip hidden when null; label pattern vs {compareLabel}; neutral when |pct|<0.05

rows.name: Cane Indent (Q) 7DMA
rows.description: Red italic companion value beside primary number.
rows.formula: SUM(daily values for 7 calendar days ending PREVIOUSDAY(To)) / dma_window; divisor always dma_window (default 7); only days present in daily map contribute to sum
rows.comparison: 7DMA is not compared; compare uses period aggregate only

rows.name: Cane Indent (Q) compare %
rows.description: Delta chip vs selected compare period.
rows.source: Derived from current and prior API rows
rows.comparison: normal: green when positive % change; (current - prior) / Math.abs(prior) * 100; null if current or prior null/blank or prior=0; Chip hidden when null; label pattern vs {compareLabel}; neutral when |pct|<0.05

rows.name: Cane Indent daily
rows.description: Area sparkline of daily indent.
rows.comparison: Daily points not individually compared

rows.comparison: normal: green when positive % change; (current - prior) / Math.abs(prior) * 100; null if current or prior null/blank or prior=0; Chip hidden when null; label pattern vs {compareLabel}; neutral when |pct|<0.05

rows.name: Ethanol Stored (BL) 7DMA
rows.description: Red italic companion value beside primary number.
rows.formula: SUM(daily values for 7 calendar days ending PREVIOUSDAY(To)) / dma_window; divisor always dma_window (default 7); only days present in daily map contribute to sum
rows.comparison: 7DMA is not compared; compare uses period aggregate only
